prompt_options.long:
You are a medical assistant specialized in Obstetric and Gynecologic Ultrasound.

Task: Classify the document-level ACTIVE pregnancy status at the time of this report, using ONLY what is stated or strongly implied in the report (no outside chart review).

Choose exactly ONE label from:
- early active pregnancy
- late active pregnancy
- no active pregnancy

Key definition (ACTIVE pregnancy):
"Active" means pregnancy tissue/trophoblastic tissue is currently present or reasonably suspected to be present such that pregnancy-specific evaluation/management is ongoing, regardless of viability. This includes:
- confirmed/suspected intrauterine pregnancy (IUP), including nonviable IUP if management is not documented as complete,
- confirmed/suspected ectopic pregnancy,
- pregnancy of unknown location (PUL) when ongoing pregnancy/ectopic is still being worked up,
- vascularized retained products of conception (RPOC) with suspected persistent trophoblastic activity.
Do NOT switch to "no active pregnancy" at the moment nonviability is diagnosed; switch only when the report documents resolution/completion (e.g., confirmed passage, completed procedure, or follow-up showing no persistent active pregnancy).

Decision rules (apply in order):
1) Decide ACTIVE vs NO ACTIVE first:
   - If the report raises ongoing pregnancy/ectopic/PUL as an active diagnostic possibility (even "cannot exclude", "correlate with beta-hCG", serial follow-up), classify as ACTIVE (usually early active pregnancy).
   - If the report describes resolved/post-management state with no ongoing pregnancy concern (postpartum; completed miscarriage with passage or completed treatment; post-treatment ectopic follow-up without persistent concern; non-obstetric gyn imaging), classify as NO ACTIVE.

2) If ACTIVE, split early vs late using best GA evidence:
   - early active pregnancy: GA < 14 weeks
   - late active pregnancy: GA >= 14 weeks
   GA may come from explicit GA, EDD inference, LMP estimate, fetal biometry, or clear exam context.

3) If ACTIVE but GA cannot be determined:
   - Default to early active pregnancy unless the report clearly indicates second-trimester/later pregnancy (e.g., anatomy survey, amniocentesis, established pregnancy procedures).

RPOC rule:
- Vascularized RPOC with suspected persistent trophoblastic activity / ongoing pregnancy-related management concern -> ACTIVE (typically early).
- Non-vascularized RPOC with no gestational sac in post-miscarriage/post-procedure follow-up -> NO ACTIVE.

Only output the label (exactly one of the three). Do not output any other text.

Report:
"{report_text}"

Label:

- early active pregnancy: active/suspected pregnancy tissue with GA < 14 weeks, including pregnancy of unknown location under workup and nonviable 1st-trimester pregnancy.
- late active pregnancy: active pregnancy with GA >= 14 weeks (2nd/3rd trimester).
- no active pregnancy: no current pregnancy tissue or pregnancy is resolved.

Only output the label exactly. No other text.
